name: Latching Wireless Mic Case
description: Precision-engineered from high-temp PETG, this latching case houses up to two wireless mic transmitters and a receiver — locked in with anti-vibration foam inserts. Clip it to your rig, drop it in your bag, or mount it on a shoulder strap. Built for the creator who never stops moving.
features: Available in Matte Black & Stealth Olive

name: Rugged Action Camera Case
tagline: Protect the shot. Own the drop.
description: A fortress for your GoPro, DJI Action, or Insta360. The ridged exoskeleton absorbs impact on hard falls while the internal silicone cradle keeps lens glass pristine. Compact enough to clip onto a backpack zipper — rugged enough for cliff jumps.
features: Compatible with GoPro 9/10/11/12, DJI Action 3/4, Insta360 X3
Lens cover port with sliding gate

name: Modular Desktop Charging Dock
description: The command center for your creator desk. Charge your phone, wireless earbuds, smartwatch, and action cam batteries simultaneously on a single sleek platform. Modular bays snap together — start with the base and expand as your kit grows. Built from matte-finish PETG that doesn't show fingerprints.
